concepts.description: One quote currency on one returned reference date under ECB methodology, directed as quote-currency units per one EUR. The pair (time, currency) is unique within one response, not an immutable cross-read identity or supported point-read key. The adapter's currency locator is scoped to that transient response. Publication may be amended; a read observation identity distinguishes consumed responses. Registration admits no execution.

Native Cube.time as a validated Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, without a time zone or midnight timestamp. Neither publication nor fetch time. A different requested date is unavailable, not the latest day.
EUR is a constant of this source definition and quote direction. It is not a native row field, not a quote of rate one and has no field binding.

bindings.note: Native code; no complete core-value coverage or country-identity claim.

concepts.description: Native uppercase currency code in the returned daily publication, naming a currency. No country, tender interval, successor or transaction role is inferred. The core currency starter values are not a complete ECB code allowlist. An absent quote stays unavailable, never zero or one.

Native positive decimal lexical string of quote-currency units per one EUR, with every supplied digit and trailing zero preserved. No binary float, fixed scale, reciprocal, cross-rate, conversion, daily average, closing or transaction-price equivalence. Exact-decimal transformations need separate admission and rounding/notice evidence. ECB rates are for information; the ECB discourages transaction use.

document.description: Authored preparatory meanings for the native time, currency and rate strings extracted from the ECB daily XML resource. EUR is explicit base context; this metadata adds no EUR row, publication instant, historical lookup, reciprocal or cross-rate. Source activation and paid applicability are blocked.
document.name: ECB daily euro foreign exchange reference quotes

sources.dataset: Euro foreign exchange reference rates daily XML
sources.note: Source rates are subject to ECB reuse conditions at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html. CC0 applies only to authored meaning/model metadata, not rates or ECB documents. No source rows, XML, snapshot or terms body are retained here.
